description_en: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) supports the publish route entry feature. You can publish routing entries from a VPC or VBR loaded into CEN to CEN by invoking the PublishRouteEntries operation. If no route conflict exists, other network instances in CEN can learn the published routes
description_zh: 云企业网支持发布路由的功能。您可以将加载到云企业网中的VPC或VBR中的路由通过调用PublishRouteEntries接口发布到云企业网中，在没有路由冲突的情况下，云企业网中的其他网络实例可以学习到该路由
kebab_example: aliyun cbn publish-route-entries --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --child-instance-id vpc-rj9gt5nll27onu0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id us-west-1 --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje70000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.1.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The route table ID of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry to be published
parameters.help_zh: 要发布的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block
